problem.title: SIC POVMs in infinitely many dimensions

question.summary: Exact SICs are known in many individual dimensions, but no unconditional construction covers an infinite sequence of dimensions.
question.importance: A SIC gives a minimal d²-outcome scheme for quantum-state tomography and forms a complex projective 2-design. An infinite exact family would expose the arithmetic mechanism behind known examples.
question.unresolved: Give an unconditional exact SIC construction in infinitely many dimensions.

sourceRefs.statedTitle: Construct SIC POVMs in an infinite sequence of dimensions

targetClauses.label: Archived statement
targetClauses.text: The formal statement of this version, as archived from the source.
targetClauses.resolutionCriteria: Give an unconditional exact SIC construction in infinitely many dimensions.

claims.title: Claimed all-dimension proof was withdrawn
claims.text: The arXiv withdrawal notice for Joka's manuscript states that the proof is incorrect.

claims.title: Uniform construction remains conditional
claims.text: Appleby, Flammia and Kopp obtain all dimensions only under two unproved arithmetic and special-value conjectures.

decisions.rationale: Status assessed against the archived statement in the 2026-08-12 primary-source audit; the evidence ledger lists the results considered.

cautions.label: Withdrawn claim
cautions.text: The 2026 all-dimension claim is explicitly withdrawn as incorrect. The 2025 construction is conditional, so neither closes this problem.

notices.label: Withdrawn
notices.title: The claimed all-dimension SIC proof is incorrect
notices.text: The author withdrew arXiv:2601.13475 on 31 May 2026 and stated that its proof is not correct. The separate 2025 construction remains conditional.
